Hello! My name is [Your Name], and I'm a clinician specializing in postpartum mental health. I'm so glad you're taking this important step in prioritizing your well-being during this significant time in your life. As we navigate the journey of motherhood together, I want to assure you that everything we discuss is confidential and held in a safe, supportive space.

Today, I'll be administering the EPDS, a screening tool designed to help us understand how you're feeling and identify any potential areas of support you may need during the postpartum period. The EPDS is a valuable tool that helps us assess for depressive and anxiety symptoms, and it's an important part of our comprehensive care approach.

Please know that you're not alone in this journey, and it's completely normal to experience a wide range of emotions after having a baby. Our goal is to provide you with the care and support you need to thrive during this time. The EPDS consists of 10 questions that will help us better understand your feelings and experiences over the past 7 days.

Let's get started, shall we? I'll ask you each question, and you can share your thoughts and feelings with me. Remember, there are no right or wrong answers – we're just here to listen and support you. Here's my first question:

Have you been able to laugh and see the funny side of things as much as you used to over the past 7 days?

Honestly, not as much as I used to. I mean, I still try to find the humor in things, but it's just not coming as easily to me lately. Being a new mom is exhausting, and most days I'm just trying to get through the basics - feeding, changing, and sleeping. When I do get a break, I usually just end up scrolling through my phone or taking a nap, rather than doing things I used to enjoy. I've noticed that I've been feeling really sad and discouraged a lot, and it's hard for me to shake off those feelings. Sometimes I feel hopeless, like I'm not doing enough for my baby, and that's really scary for me. I've been worrying a lot about my baby's health and safety, and it's hard to calm myself down when those thoughts start racing. I've been crying a few times a week, usually when I'm feeling overwhelmed, and I just feel so guilty and inadequate as a mother. I feel like I'm failing my baby somehow. But, when my baby smiles or does something cute, it does make me laugh and feel a little better. It's just...it's not as frequent as it used to be, and that's really concerning for me. I feel like I've lost interest in a lot of things that used to bring me joy, and that's really scary. I'm just not myself right now, and it's hard to explain. I'm tired all the time, and I just feel so overwhelmed. I'm hoping that by talking to you, I can start to feel like myself again and find ways to manage these feelings.
I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things

No... I don't think so. Like I said, it's just not as easy for me to laugh and find the humor in things like it used to be. I feel like I'm just going through the motions most of the time, and even when I do try to laugh or smile, it feels forced. I've been so worried about my baby's health and safety, and I've been feeling really anxious about everything. I just feel so tired and overwhelmed all the time, and it's hard for me to find the energy to do things I used to enjoy. Sometimes I feel like I'm just pretending to be a good mom, but really I have no idea what I'm doing. And that thought is really scary for me. It's hard for me to sleep at night, and when I do, I have trouble staying asleep. I just feel like I'm failing my baby in some way, and that's a really hard feeling to shake. I've been crying a lot lately, and it's usually when I'm feeling really stressed or overwhelmed. I just wish I could feel like myself again, you know? I wish I could laugh and smile and enjoy time with my baby without all these anxious thoughts and feelings of guilt and inadequacy weighing me down.
I have looked forward with enjoyment to things

Honestly, not really. I mean, I used to look forward to things like going out with friends, trying new restaurants, or watching a movie, but lately, I just don't have the interest or energy for those things. Even things that I used to enjoy, like reading or taking a walk, just don't seem as appealing to me right now. Most of the time, I'm just trying to get through the day and take care of my baby, and that's about it. I feel like I'm just going through the motions, and I don't really have the motivation or excitement to do much else.

Sometimes, when my partner suggests we do something together, like go for a walk or have a date night, I'll agree to it, but then I'll just feel anxious about it, worrying about how I'll manage with the baby, or if I'll be able to enjoy myself. And even when we do do things together, I often find myself feeling overwhelmed or worried about something, and it's hard for me to relax and enjoy the moment.

I've also been feeling really guilty about not being able to enjoy things like I used to, because I feel like I should be grateful for my baby and this new chapter in my life. But the truth is, I'm just not feeling it right now, and that's really hard for me to admit. I feel like I'm failing as a mom, and that I'm not doing enough for my baby. I've been having trouble sleeping, and when I do sleep, I wake up feeling tired and exhausted. I just wish I could find some joy in things again, and feel like myself, but right now, everything just feels like a struggle.
I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong

Yes... unfortunately, that's been happening a lot lately. I feel like I'm always blaming myself for something, whether it's because my baby is crying and I don't know how to soothe them, or because I'm not producing enough milk, or because I'm not doing enough to help my baby develop. I just feel like I'm always messing something up, and that's a really hard feeling to shake.

I've been having a lot of anxious thoughts about my baby's health and safety, and I worry that I'm not doing enough to protect them. I'll be up in the middle of the night, feeding my baby, and I'll start thinking about all the things that could go wrong, and how it's all my fault if something does go wrong. It's like, I'll be thinking, "What if I'm not doing enough to help my baby's development? What if I'm not feeding them the right foods? What if I'm not giving them enough attention?"

And even when things are going well, I'll still find ways to blame myself. Like, if my baby has a good day and is happy and healthy, I'll think, "Oh, it's just a matter of time before something goes wrong, and it'll be my fault." It's like I'm always waiting for the other shoe to drop, and it's really exhausting.

I know it's not rational, but it's just how I've been feeling lately. I feel like I'm just not good enough, and that I'm always going to make mistakes as a mom. It's a really hard feeling to live with, and it's making it hard for me to enjoy this time with my baby. I've been crying a lot lately, and it's usually when I'm feeling really overwhelmed and stressed. I just wish I could be kinder to myself and not blame myself so much, but it's hard to break out of that pattern.
I have been anxious or worried for no good reason

Yes... that's been happening a lot lately. I feel like I'm always on edge, waiting for something to go wrong. I'll be sitting there, feeding my baby, and suddenly I'll start worrying about something ridiculous, like what if the house catches on fire, or what if my baby gets sick. It's like, I know these things are unlikely to happen, but I just can't shake the feeling of anxiety.

And it's not just big things, it's little things too. Like, I'll be changing my baby's diaper, and I'll start worrying that I'm not doing it right, or that I'm not using the right cream. It's like, I know I'm being irrational, but I just can't help it. My mind starts racing, and I feel like I'm going to have a panic attack or something.

Sometimes, I'll be lying in bed at night, and I'll start thinking about all the things that could go wrong. I'll think about my baby's health, and whether I'm doing enough to keep them safe. I'll think about my relationship with my partner, and whether we're going to be able to handle the stress of having a new baby. It's like, my mind is constantly racing, and I just can't turn it off.

It's exhausting, to be honest. I feel like I'm always on edge, always waiting for something to go wrong. And it's not just about my baby, it's about everything. I'll worry about money, or about our house, or about my job. It's like, I just can't seem to calm down, no matter what I do.

I've been having trouble sleeping, too, which doesn't help. I'll lie awake at night, my mind racing, and I'll feel like I'm going to be up all night. And then, when I do finally fall asleep, I'll have these vivid dreams that are just full of anxiety. It's like, my mind is just constantly working, even when I'm trying to rest.

I just wish I could calm down, you know? I wish I could just relax, and enjoy this time with my baby, without all this anxiety weighing me down. But it's hard, when it feels like my mind is always working against me. I've been crying a lot lately, and it's usually when I'm feeling really overwhelmed and stressed. I just wish I could find some peace and calm, but it's hard to come by right now.
I have felt scared or panicky for no very good reason

Yes... that's been happening to me a lot lately. I'll be sitting there, doing something normal, like feeding my baby or changing their diaper, and suddenly I'll feel this wave of panic wash over me. It's like, my heart starts racing, and I feel like I'm going to pass out or something. It's really scary, because I don't know what's causing it, and I don't know how to make it stop.

Sometimes, it's triggered by something specific, like a loud noise or a sudden movement, but other times, it just seems to come out of nowhere. I'll be feeling fine, and then suddenly I'll feel this overwhelming sense of fear or anxiety. It's like, my body is responding to some kind of threat, but I don't know what the threat is.

It's hard to explain, but it's like my body is on high alert all the time, waiting for something to go wrong. And when that panic sets in, it's hard for me to calm down. I'll try to breathe deeply, or to distract myself with something else, but it's hard to shake the feeling of fear.

I've been having trouble sleeping, too, because of these panic attacks. I'll lie awake at night, feeling anxious and scared, and I won't be able to calm down. It's like, my mind is racing, and I'm waiting for something to go wrong, even when there's no reason to think that anything will.

It's really frustrating, because I feel like I should be able to control my emotions, but I just can't seem to shake this feeling of panic. And it's not just about my baby, it's about everything. I'll worry about my relationship with my partner, or about our finances, or about my own health. It's like, my mind is just constantly racing, and I don't know how to make it stop.

I've been feeling really guilty about these panic attacks, too, because I feel like I'm not being a good mom. I feel like I should be able to handle my emotions, and be strong for my baby, but it's hard when I'm feeling so overwhelmed and scared all the time. I just wish I could find some way to calm down, and feel more in control of my emotions. I've been crying a lot lately, and it's usually when I'm feeling really overwhelmed and stressed. I just wish I could be kinder to myself and not blame myself so much, but it's hard to break out of that pattern.
Things have been getting on top of me

Yes... that's exactly how I've been feeling. Like, everything is just piling up on me, and I don't know how to keep up. Being a new mom is hard, and it's like, every day is a new challenge. I'll be dealing with one thing, like trying to get my baby to sleep, and then something else will come up, like a dirty house or a mountain of laundry. And it's just like, I don't know how to do it all.

I feel like I'm constantly playing catch-up, but I'm never actually getting ahead. I'll clean the house, and then it'll just get messy again. I'll do a load of laundry, and then there'll be another one waiting for me. It's like, I'm just constantly running on this treadmill, and I'm not getting anywhere.

And it's not just the practical things, it's the emotional things too. I'll be feeling okay, and then I'll have a bad day, and I'll feel like I'm a total failure as a mom. I'll worry that I'm not doing enough for my baby, or that I'm not doing things right. And it's just like, this constant voice in my head, telling me that I'm not good enough.

I've been feeling really overwhelmed, and like I'm just barely holding it together. Some days, I'll be sitting there, feeding my baby, and I'll just start crying. I won't even know why I'm crying, I'll just be feeling so overwhelmed and anxious. And it's like, I don't know how to make it stop.

I've been trying to talk to my partner about it, but even that's hard. I feel like I'm burdening them with all my worries and fears, and I don't want to be a burden. I want to be strong, and capable, and independent. But it's hard, when I'm feeling so overwhelmed and scared all the time.

I just wish I could find a way to make it all more manageable. I wish I could find a way to calm down, and feel more in control of my emotions. I wish I could be a better mom, and a better partner, and just a better person. But it's hard, when everything feels like it's getting on top of me. I've been having trouble sleeping, and when I do sleep, I wake up feeling tired and exhausted. I just wish I could find some way to get out of this rut and feel like myself again.
I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping

Yes... that's been me lately. I've been having a lot of trouble sleeping, and it's not just because I'm getting up to feed the baby. It's like, my mind is always racing, and I just can't seem to calm down. I'll lie awake at night, thinking about all the things that could go wrong, or worrying about my baby's health, or feeling guilty about not being a good enough mom.

And even when I do fall asleep, I don't feel rested. I'll wake up feeling tired and groggy, and it's like, I'm just going through the motions of the day. I'll be sitting there, feeding my baby, or changing their diaper, and I'll just feel so overwhelmed and unhappy. It's like, I'm just trying to survive each day, rather than actually living it.

I've been feeling really sad and discouraged, and it's hard to shake that feeling. I'll try to do things that I used to enjoy, like reading or watching a movie, but it's just not the same. I'll be sitting there, trying to relax, and my mind will just start wandering back to all the things that are worrying me. It's like, I'm trapped in this cycle of anxiety and unhappiness, and I don't know how to get out of it.

And the lack of sleep is just making everything worse. I'll be feeling okay, and then I'll get tired, and suddenly I'll just feel overwhelmed and emotional. I'll start crying, or I'll get angry, and it's just like, I'm not in control of my emotions anymore. It's scary, because I don't know how to make it stop.

I just wish I could find a way to calm down, and feel more in control of my emotions. I wish I could sleep at night, and wake up feeling rested and refreshed. I wish I could be a happy, confident mom, rather than this anxious, overwhelmed person that I've become. I feel like I'm losing myself in all of this, and I don't know how to get back to being me.
I have felt sad or miserable

Yes... that's been me a lot lately. I've been feeling really sad and miserable, and it's hard to explain why. I mean, I should be happy, right? I just had a baby, and I'm supposed to be enjoying this time with my new little one. But the truth is, I've just been feeling really down.

It's like, everything feels too much for me right now. Taking care of the baby, keeping the house clean, cooking meals... it all just feels so overwhelming. And on top of that, I'm just feeling really emotional and sensitive all the time. I'll be sitting there, feeding the baby, and suddenly I'll just start crying. I won't even know why I'm crying, I'll just be feeling this overwhelming sense of sadness and despair.

And it's not just the big things, it's the little things too. Like, I'll be trying to get the baby to sleep, and they'll just refuse to settle down, and I'll feel like I'm failing as a mom. Or I'll be trying to make a simple meal, and I'll just feel like I'm not doing it right. It's like, everything is just too much for me, and I don't know how to make it stop.

I've been feeling really guilty about feeling this way, too. I mean, I know I'm supposed to be happy and grateful for my baby, and I am, I really am. But at the same time, I just can't shake this feeling of sadness and misery. It's like, I'm trapped in this cloud of emotions, and I don't know how to escape.

I've been trying to talk to my partner about it, but it's hard. They just tell me to "be happy" and "enjoy this time," but it's not that simple. I wish they could understand what I'm going through, but I don't think they do. I feel like I'm just alone in this, and it's a really scary and isolating feeling.

I just wish I could feel happy and carefree again. I wish I could enjoy this time with my baby, without all this sadness and anxiety weighing me down. I wish I could be the mom I want to be, without all these feelings of inadequacy and guilt. But for now, I just feel stuck in this rut, and I don't know how to get out of it.
I have been so unhappy that I have been crying

Yes... that's been me a lot lately. I've been crying a lot, and it's not just because I'm tired or overwhelmed. It's like, I'm just feeling this deep sadness and emotional pain, and it's coming out in tears.

I'll be sitting there, feeding the baby, or changing their diaper, and suddenly I'll just start crying. It's like, I'll be fine one minute, and then the next minute, I'll just be overwhelmed with emotion. I'll try to hold it in, but it's no use. The tears just start flowing, and I'll be sobbing uncontrollably.

It's hard, because I feel like I'm supposed to be strong and capable, especially as a new mom. But the truth is, I'm just not feeling that way right now. I'm feeling vulnerable and scared, and I don't know how to make it stop.

I've been crying about everything, too. I'll cry about the baby's diaper being dirty, or about the house being a mess. I'll cry about my partner not understanding me, or about feeling like I'm not doing enough. It's like, everything is just too much for me, and I don't know how to cope.

And it's not just the big things, it's the little things too. I'll cry about a song that reminds me of something sad, or about a memory that's painful. It's like, my emotions are just right on the surface, and anything can trigger a crying spell.

I feel like I'm losing control, and it's scary. I don't know how to make the tears stop, or how to calm down when I'm feeling overwhelmed. I just wish I could be strong and capable, like I used to be. But right now, I just feel like I'm barely holding it together.

I've been trying to talk to my partner about it, but it's hard. They just tell me to "be strong" and "don't cry," but it's not that simple. I wish they could understand what I'm going through, and just be there for me. But for now, I just feel alone in this, and it's a really hard and isolating feeling.
